title: Mempool Surf Club Explore — Exchanges Research Registry
scope: Research-only registry section for the EXCHANGES category. This file does not publish or activate Explore content.

source_of_truth.rule: The manifest plus all listed record shards together are the canonical machine-readable source. Command Center review is required before promotion to a Master Explore Registry.

registry_wide_rules.one_entity_one_profile: One canonical profile per exchange/company/service entity. Trading interfaces, regional product variants and adjacent wallets/payments are relationships unless a materially separate canonical entity is required.
registry_wide_rules.status_rule: Lifecycle status is independent from legal uncertainty or historical importance. ACTIVE requires verified current exchange/broker/operator activity as of the record date. HISTORICAL is for finite/legacy phases where operation is not itself best described as ceased/abandoned. INACTIVE applies when exchange operation ceased or the business was wound down without an active successor under the same canonical entity. UNCERTAIN is only for unresolved lifecycle.
registry_wide_rules.exchange_model_rule: Use precise labels for order-book exchange, broker/dealer, custodial app, OTC venue, P2P coordinator and derivatives venue. Do not call every Bitcoin purchase app an order-book exchange.
registry_wide_rules.custody_rule: Distinguish platform custody from self-custody, third-party custody, multisig escrow, Lightning hold invoices and no-escrow coordination. 'Non-custodial' never means zero counterparty or dispute risk.
registry_wide_rules.regulatory_rule: Registration, licensing, authorization and legal availability are jurisdiction/entity specific and time-sensitive. Date material claims and do not summarize a venue as simply 'regulated'.
registry_wide_rules.lightning_rule: Lightning support is verified as a feature as of the record date and does not itself justify inclusion. Distinguish Lightning Network functionality from similarly named trading products.
registry_wide_rules.proof_of_reserves_rule: Exchange proofs/attestations must be described by scope. Proof of reserves/assets/liabilities is not automatically proof of total corporate solvency.
registry_wide_rules.publication_rule: Recommended slugs/descriptions are planning data only. No Shopify, Atlas, production routes or public profiles are created by this registry.
registry_wide_rules.source_rule: Source hierarchy: official exchange/company pages and docs; official legal/support/API/status filings; primary regulatory/licensing records; primary Bitcoin documentation; reputable independent reporting/research; market-data/rankings only as supporting evidence.
registry_wide_rules.cross_category_rule: Entities canonically better housed in WALLETS, PAYMENTS, MARKETPLACES, MINING or NETWORK are linked rather than duplicated.
registry_wide_rules.source_confidence_rule: Source confidence is independent from lifecycle. HIGH means first-party or primary evidence supports identity and core claims including lifecycle/model. MEDIUM means credible evidence exists but one or more core history/model fields depend on incomplete archival or indirect evidence. LOW means core evidence is materially indirect.
registry_wide_rules.source_type_rule: Controlled source_type values: official, official-github, primary, on-chain, independent, indexer, marketplace, market-data.
registry_wide_rules.uncertainty_rule: Unresolved founder attribution, legal scope, closure timing, feature availability or corporate lineage belongs in Verification basis / Research notes; it does not automatically require UNCERTAIN lifecycle.

topic_architecture.purpose: Bitcoin-first brokerage, dealer and regional on-ramp businesses where buying or selling BTC is a core product, including direct-to-wallet and custodial models.
subtopics: Bitcoin-focused brokerage interface with third-party custody

topic_architecture.purpose: Custodial order-book and multi-market exchanges with durable Bitcoin liquidity, fiat-market, regulatory or historical significance beyond merely listing BTC.
Peer-to-peer Bitcoin exchange systems whose coordination, escrow and settlement design materially differs from conventional custodial exchange accounts.
Institutional spot/OTC and derivatives venues that materially changed Bitcoin price discovery, professional execution or hedging.
Defunct venues and early on-ramp infrastructure whose operation materially explains the evolution of Bitcoin custody, P2P access, fiat markets and institutional execution.

required_record_fields: Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange ecosystem

field_rules.Official website: Canonical entity-controlled website when verified; null is allowed for defunct entities and must not be replaced by an unrelated directory.
field_rules.Official sources: First-party or authoritative primary sources supporting identity, history, exchange model, custody, technical features, lifecycle or legal context.
field_rules.Corroborating sources: Independent/primary/regulatory/market-data evidence used to corroborate rather than manufacture claims.
field_rules.Last verified date: ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of substantive verification; time-sensitive exchange features/legal claims require current recheck before public publication.
field_rules.Verification basis: Concise statement of evidence supporting lifecycle, model and core claims.
field_rules.Research notes / uncertainties: Explicit unresolved facts and publication cautions; uncertainty here does not automatically mean UNCERTAIN lifecycle.
field_rules.Related projects / entities: Product lineages or related entities. Use relationships instead of duplicate profiles.
field_rules.Related Explore categories: Cross-category relationship destinations only; do not duplicate the same canonical entity in multiple category registries.

inventory_standard.principle: Bitcoin must be materially important to the entity's history, product or market-structure role; listing BTC alone is not enough.
inventory_standard.anti_padding_rule: Large multiasset exchanges were excluded when their only Bitcoin case was scale or the presence of BTC markets already represented by stronger canonical examples.
